name: Sailboat
description: The team imagines itself on a sailboat: the wind pushes it forward, anchors hold it back, rocks are risks ahead, and the island is the goal. A playful way to look at a project.

columns.name: Wind
columns.prompt: What is pushing us forward and helping us?

columns.name: Anchors
columns.prompt: What is slowing us down or holding us back?

columns.name: Rocks
columns.prompt: What risks could hurt us in the future?

columns.name: Island
columns.prompt: What is our goal and what does it look like?

mood.energized: A lively picture gets an energized team going.

goal.fun: The sailing picture makes it playful.
goal.bond: Drawing the boat together is a shared activity.
goal.reflect-project: Looks at progress, obstacles and the goal.

checkInQuestion: If our team were a boat, what kind of boat would we be today?
facilitationTips: Draw a boat, wind, anchors, rocks and an island on a whiteboard before people arrive.
Spend a minute on the island first so everybody shares the same goal.
Handle rocks last and decide who watches each risk.
